name: Edward VIII
role: King of the United Kingdom and Emperor of India (1936); later Duke of Windsor
summary: Edward VIII reigned for under a year before abdicating to marry Wallis Simpson, and his recorded political statements are few. He accepted that the monarch must yield to ministers and Parliament, appealed publicly for peace before the Second World War, and wrote private remarks reflecting the racial hierarchies common in his era. Reports of pro-German sympathies rest largely on secondhand accounts and disputed documents.
